owned_invariants: One response line per non-blank request line.
Only the five documented methods exist.
boundaries: Requests over MAX_JSON_BYTES are refused before parsing.

score.level_basis: Protocol server for the C# app: JSON-RPC 2.0 framing, envelope validation, method table, and a fixed translation of each expected failure to a JSON-RPC error with a stable data code; unexpected failures end the process (fail-closed) for the client to report.

basis.G1: Header declares AuthorityEffect: None and a unique contract URN; the exported names (__all__ or public types) are the ones the docstring describes and the contract lists. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond this contract.
basis.G2: Non-Numeric profile: inputs are admitted by strict Pydantic models before use (RULE_PY_001) and outputs are typed; behaviour matches the documented contract in the module docstring and README. Envelope, id, size and parse errors are distinguished as the JSON-RPC spec requires.
basis.G3: Every expected failure is a typed exception with a stable code (AdmissionError, BudgetExceededError, UnknownPackError) or a typed verdict; no assert in production code (Ruff S101, AST test) and the whole suite passes under python -O; no bare or broad except (Ruff BLE001/E722). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit and boundary tests for every branch, negative tests for each refusal, run under pytest and under python -O. Every error code and malformed-request class is tested; C# contract tests exercise it end to end. Mutation R = 1/1 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Functions are single-purpose; complexity measured per function. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 6, cognitive 5, nesting 2; metrics ceiling A+.
